accepted.s: The Andhra Pradesh IT Policy 2021-24 was notified primarily with which objective?
o: To boost growth and employment generation
To establish only semiconductor fabrication units
To replace the State GST framework
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh IT Policy 2021-24 was notified to promote growth and generate employment in the information technology sector.
accepted.tq: Identify the stated policy objective rather than being distracted by unrelated sectoral functions.
accepted.sec: AP IT policies - IT Policy 2021-24, IT & GCC Policy 4.0

accepted.s: The Andhra Pradesh IT & GCC Policy 4.0, 2024-29, came into force on:
accepted.x: The AP IT & GCC Policy 4.0, covering 2024-29, came into force on 12 December 2024.
accepted.tq: Use precise date discrimination among closely spaced policy years.
accepted.sec: AP IT policies - IT Policy 2021-24, IT & GCC Policy 4.0

accepted.s: Which one of the following best describes the broad aim of the Andhra Pradesh IT & GCC Policy 4.0?
o: To restrict multinational companies to urban municipalities
To shift all IT activity outside the coastal region
To promote only government-owned software companies
To make Andhra Pradesh a global knowledge economy hub
accepted.x: The policy aims to position Andhra Pradesh as a global knowledge economy hub.
accepted.tq: Match the policy with its broad vision, avoiding extreme and restrictive distractors.
accepted.sec: AP IT policies - IT Policy 2021-24, IT & GCC Policy 4.0

accepted.s: The co-working and neighbourhood workspaces proposed under the Andhra Pradesh IT & GCC Policy 4.0 include which set of cities?
accepted.x: The policy identifies Tirupati, Visakhapatnam and Vijayawada for co-working and neighbourhood workspaces.
accepted.tq: Test the exact membership of a location-based policy list.
accepted.sec: AP IT policies - IT Policy 2021-24, IT & GCC Policy 4.0

accepted.s: A Global Capability Centre (GCC), in the context of Andhra Pradesh's IT policy, is best understood as:
o: A multinational company's own offshore unit
A public sector semiconductor testing laboratory
A third-party vendor supplying temporary clerical staff
accepted.x: A GCC is an offshore unit owned and operated by a multinational company for its own capabilities and operations, rather than a third-party vendor.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between a multinational's captive unit and an outsourced third-party service provider.
accepted.sec: AP IT policies - IT Policy 2021-24, IT & GCC Policy 4.0

accepted.s: An IT Park for Phenom People is associated with which of the following locations and investment details?

18 acres at Tirupati, with an investment of ₹100 crore

accepted.s: Which of the following statements correctly describes the proposed timeline of Quantum Valley Amaravati?
